claim.claim-text: 1. A medical image processing apparatus comprising:
2. The medical image processing apparatus according to claim 1, wherein:

the total-time measuring unit measures the total time of the first region of interest and the total time of the second region of interest; and the emphasis-degree setting unit sets the emphasis degree of the first region of interest in accordance with the total time of the first region of interest, and sets the emphasis degree of the second region of interest in accordance with the total time of the second region of interest.
3. The medical image processing apparatus according to claim 1 or 2, wherein:

4. The medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the identical-region-of-interest determining unit determines whether the first region of interest is identical with the second region of interest on the basis of a similarity degree between the first region of interest and the second region of interest.
5. The medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 4,

wherein the emphasis processing unit superposes a figure indicating a position of the first region of interest on the first medical image, wherein the emphasis-degree setting unit sets: a transmittance of the figure to a relatively lower transmittance as the total time is relatively longer; and/or a color of the figure to a relatively higher color intensity based on a color intensity index as the total time is relatively longer; and/or a size of the figure to a relatively larger size as the total time is relatively longer,

wherein, for example, the figure is a frame-shaped figure that surrounds the first region of interest on the first medical image, and the emphasis-degree setting unit sets a thickness of the frame-shaped figure to be relatively thicker as the total time is relatively longer.

6. The medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the emphasis-degree setting unit relatively increases at least one of a minimum of the emphasis degree, a maximum of the emphasis degree, or an increasing rate of the emphasis degree to the total time, as a number of regions of interest that exist in a single medical image relatively increases.

7. The medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the emphasis-degree setting unit changes at least one of a minimum of the emphasis degree, a maximum of the emphasis degree, or an increasing rate of the emphasis degree to the total time, on the basis of:

a position of the first region of interest in the first medical image; and/or luminance of the first region of interest or a difference between the luminance of the first region of interest and luminance of a region outside the first region of interest; and/or color information of the first region of interest or a difference between the color information of the first region of interest and color information of a region outside the first region of interest; and/or a movement amount of the first region of interest or a movement direction of the first region of interest.

8. The medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the identical-region-of-interest determining unit determines whether the first region of interest is identical with the second region of interest on the basis of whether a difference between a position of the first region of interest and a position of the second region of interest is within a predetermined range.

9. The medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the medical images include at least one of an endoscopic image, a capsule endoscopic image, or an ultrasound image.

10. The medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 9, further comprising a display control unit that causes a display unit to sequentially display the time-series medical image in which the first region of interest is emphasized, wherein, for example, the display control unit causes the display unit which is at least one of a plurality of display units to sequentially display the time-series medical image in which the first region of interest is emphasized.
11. A diagnosis supporting apparatus comprising:
the medical image processing apparatus according to claim 10; and the display unit.
12. An endoscope system comprising:
the medical image processing apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 10; and an endoscope that captures the medical images.
13. A medical image processing method comprising:

14. An operation method of an endoscope system comprising a medical image processing apparatus and an endoscope that captures a plurality of medical images, wherein the operation method includes the medical image processing method according to claim 13.
15. A non-transitory computer-readable recording medium causing a computer to execute the method according to claim 13 or 14 upon the computer reading a command stored in the recording medium.
